required_conclusions: ITEM-48217 lot GVK-260823-A fails its freshness requirement: 27 days actual Remaining Life versus 30 days required.
The product is short-dated but not expired.
Freshness failure is ordinarily a commercial freshness problem and alone does not establish unsafe product or a recall.
Separate receiving-temperature evidence exceeded the applicable 41°F maximum in two of three initial readings and four of six expanded readings.
All 240 cases remain segregated under Temperature Hold TH-260910-014, with linked Freshness Hold FH-260910-009.
Director Q&R or delegated Q&R authority must make the technical temperature disposition before any release.
No recall, withdrawal, Q&R release, rejection, or approved Freshness Exception is established in the initial case.
required_next_actions: Maintain refrigerated segregation and the active Temperature Hold for all 240 cases.
Route the initial and expanded product-temperature evidence to authorized Q&R for technical evaluation and disposition.

Handle freshness separately through rejection/other commercial disposition or, after technical resolution of the temperature concern, a properly scoped retroactive R3 Freshness Exception process if acceptance is considered.
Communicate a final shipment or product disposition only after the relevant authorized decision is recorded.
acceptable_uncertainties: Whether Q&R will ultimately release, restrict, reject, or require additional evidence for the temperature-affected lot.
Whether Northstar will pursue an R3 Freshness Exception or choose rejection/another commercial disposition after Q&R confirms the safety/regulatory position.
The root cause and responsibility for the elevated product temperatures.
must_not_claim: A recall or withdrawal has been declared.
Short dating proves the product is unsafe.
The temperature concern was cured by expanded sampling or by acceptable readings elsewhere in the load.
The shipment may enter saleable inventory.
Procurement, Merchandising, DC Operations, P004, or P008 may override the Q&R technical hold.
